record_hint: Use the MCP tools mech_record_decision, mech_record_impression, mech_record_vision_review, mech_record_reconcile, mech_record_read, mech_record_insight and mech_record_song_receipt (or `python -m mech record <kind> --json <file>`). Impressions need 400+ characters, 3+ sentences, facets (observed, works, concerns, feelings, next_actions), claims quoting exact tokens from the artifacts, and an upstream entry for every sister impression you took in. Search sister impressions with mech_records_search / mech_records_digest.
